# African Studies Minor
Source: https://academiccatalog.umd.edu/undergraduate/colleges-schools/behavioral-social-sciences/african-american-africana-studies/african-studies-minor/
Fetched: 2026-09-28

## Catalog requirements

The African Studies Minor will include a total of 15 (18 if the student elects to pursue the optional Capstone offering) composed of the following:
Course | Title | Credits
Foundational Course
AAAS200 | African Civilization | 3
Courses of Choice (two must be at the upper level)
Area 1: History, Culture, and Language (2 courses) | 6
AAAS310 | African Slave Trade
AAAS398 | Selected Topics in the African Diaspora
AAAS468 | Special Topics in Africa and the Americas
CMLT235 | Black Diaspora Literature and Culture
ENGL360 | African, Indian and Caribbean Writers
ENGL368 | Special Topics in African American, African, and African Diaspora Literatures (topics vary; must be approved)
HIST254 | African-American History to 1865
HIST310 | History of South Africa
HIST319 | Special Topics in History (The African City: From Ancient Mali to Modern Johannesburg)
HIST428 | Selected Topics in History (HIST428B: Seven Revolutions in Post War Africa)
LANGUAGE | Any approved African language course 1
Area 2: Politics, Society, and Development (2 courses) | 6
AAAS190 | HIV/AIDS in a Global Perspective
AAAS410 | Contemporary African Ideologies
AAAS398 | Selected Topics in the African Diaspora
AAAS468 | Special Topics in Africa and the Americas
AREC365 | World Hunger, Population, and Food Supplies
ECON315 | Economic Development of Underdeveloped Areas
GEOG130 | Development Geography: Environmental & Social Justice
GEOG422 | Changing Geographies of Sub-Saharan Africa
GVPT282 | The Politics of Global Development
Capstone Course (optional)
AAAS400 | Directed Readings in African American and Africana Studies
AAAS402 | Classic Readings in African American and Africana Studies
AAAS468 | Special Topics in Africa and the Americas (AAAS468Z: South Africa Study Abroad Seminar)
Total Credits | 15
1
